result.reason: The redline appropriately makes the restriction mutual, limits it to directly involved personnel, retains general-advertising and unsolicited-inquiry carve-outs, and does not impose a no-hire. However, the fallback requires the 12-month period to run from the end of each individual’s involvement, whereas this clause runs through 12 months after expiration or termination of the entire Agreement. That could restrict solicitation substantially longer than permitted for personnel whose involvement ended earlier. The phrase “performance or receipt of the activities” is also less precise than referring to the services.
